tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, so there is no build type in which certificates go unverified. This is consistent with the project's separate decision to use HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a one-paragraph statement. It says TLS certificate verification is on for all builds, development builds included. It also notes that this fits the separate decision to use HTTPS everywhere with no plaintext exceptions.

Both points come from the project's recorded decisions (#29 and #32). The earlier record that allowed dev builds to skip verification was withdrawn, so the file doesn't mention it.

The Muninn health line reported that 20 hook runs started and never finished. I didn't investigate it. It doesn't affect the file, but the hooks may be timing out.
